name: prompt-it
description: Perform automatic proportional planning for substantial tasks and draft an evidence-backed execution brief before implementation. Small tasks plan and run; medium/large tasks ask Proceed? before starting.

interface.shortDescription: Plan automatically and review the plan before work starts.
interface.longDescription: Perform automatic proportional planning, research the approved task read-only, and produce an evidence-backed execution brief with explicit model staffing and economical Side Lane routing for approval.
defaultPrompt: Research this request and draft a brief for review.
